case_title: PRAKASH NAYI @ SEN v. STATE OF GOA
neutral_facts: The accused attacked the deceased at a store where the deceased was working, using an iron locking plate without any provocation or premeditation. The incident occurred on 14.05.2004 at 6:00 a.m. The accused was treated at a hospital prior to the incident for anxiety neurosis with reactive depression, acid peptic disease, and mild hypertension, with treatment akin to that for schizophrenia. The accused was examined by two doctors who opined he suffered from schizophrenia. The trial court convicted the accused, but the Supreme Court overturned the conviction, finding the courts below erred in not accepting the medical reports and in not considering the accused's prior insanity. The accused was found to be unfit to stand trial at the time of the incident, and his subsequent fitness to face trial was deemed indicative of his prior insanity.
